brief: An investment fund that acquires industrial and logistics assets with large existing grid connections. The identity should feel disciplined, durable and confident, with one clear idea about power that investors remember.
criteria: Success: one idea, readable as a name at any size, works in one colour and reversed, ownable beyond the generic power icon.

concepts.name: MORE POWER
concepts.idea: Each O in the name is a power switch: MORE is navy with a blue switch, POWER is blue with a navy switch. In the mark, the two switches are coupled and meet in one shared core.
rationale: Two words, two power switches, one connected system
The mark is the two Os of the name, coupled like circuits
Inter Display with custom Os; outlined artwork, no live type

recommendation: Primary wordmark for general use, stacked lockup for square formats and signage, the mark for icons and avatars, and the shared-O lockup only for expressive campaign use.
next_steps: Roll out to deck, website and signage
